api_key: sk-devin-<generated on first run; leave empty to regenerate>
tokens_file: <optional: one devin-session-token$... per line, rotated one account per request>
proxies_file: <optional: one proxy URL per line, rotated one route per request; socks5://, socks5h://, http://, https://, or direct>
dashboard_password: <optional: at least 8 characters; leave empty and one is generated and printed once, with only its hash stored>
devin_cli: <optional: path to devin.exe; its path is shown in the terminal command the dashboard offers, and the sign-out endpoint runs it. The sign-in itself is done in-process and does not need it>
dashboard_webapp_host: <optional: where the dashboard's sign-in page lives, for a deployment other than app.devin.ai; must be the host serving /auth/cli/continue>
dashboard_echo_url: <optional: an endpoint answering with the caller's address as plain text, fetched through a route when it is tested; "-" skips it>
